title: Product-analytics overview — Lumetric (SaaS analytics)
notes: v2 is a Next.js rewrite with CSS-modules class hashes. The date-range presets and the compare toggle move into a <date-range-picker> web component (declarative shadow root) with relabelled presets ('30D' -> 'Last 30 days') and a new 'Yesterday'/'Last 12 months' option; a hidden mobile filter sheet repeats the presets. KPI cards are reordered and a 'Stickiness' card is added; ids/test ids are gone. The chart panels swap places, intervals become Hour/Day/Week/Month and a new 'Sessions' chart repeats the same tabs. Top pages is re-sorted by pageviews, gains a 'Change' column and its own 'Export' button. A help launcher web component and an announcement banner are added.
